newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Manugistics Q3 view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Manugistics Q3 view raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it raised its Q3 earnings per share expectations on Manugistics Group Inc to $0.16 from $0.15 and its revenue outlook to $22.6 million from $21.8 million.
--"We believe the company produced a solid third quarter and has a strong pipeline going into their year-end," analyst William Lanzon noted in a report.
--The software company is expected to report fiscal Q3 results on Tuesday after the market closes, EVEREN said.
